scope.purpose: Inventory and preserve the existing historical/deterministic M10A GOLD LONG reference artifacts before deciding which frozen LONG arms are eligible for future M10W integrated LONG+SHORT reconstruction.

required_inventory: JSON top-level keys plus stage/status/arm-like structures
verbatim copy of source JSON/CSV/TXT/LOG artifacts into one upload package
decision_rule: M10W0 itself does not select or reject a LONG arm. It only exposes the frozen evidence. Eligibility is decided after user-local evidence review, without using M10P/M10P2 prospective outcomes.
